title: Iloilo transport alliance rejects people's strike

blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — An alliance representing 11 transport cooperatives in Iloilo has rejected calls for a transport or people’s strike, saying a work stoppage would hurt commuters, businesses and students without resolving the problems confronting the public transport sector. The Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporations, Inc. (WVATCCI), in a statement issued Monday, said it would instead pursue dialogue with government agencies over rising fuel costs, fare concerns, government assistance, and the continued operation of colorum or unauthorized public utility vehicles. WVATCCI represents 11 transport cooperatives covering a significant portion of Iloilo’s public utility jeepney routes, according to previous […]...
